description: This file contains functions for platform-specific operations related to image upgrade processes. It includes functions to check the image compatibility, copy configuration data, and perform the upgrade procedure, involving partition management, image extraction, and device writing.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks if the partition layout in the image matches the current device, indicating if a full image write is necessary.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies backup configuration data to a specified partition.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the upgrade process, including partition comparison, image writing, and device partition adjustments.
